editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your family business is falling apart and your marriage is hitting a wall at the same time. That is exactly where you find the main character in this drama. He is a small business owner in Turin who took over the company from his dad, but now a huge economic crash is putting everything at risk. You can really feel his stress as he tries to keep his head above water while accidentally pushing away the people he loves most. It is a slow-burn story that looks at how money and pressure can change a person for the worse.

What really works here is the acting, as you get to see a man slowly lose his cool. The pacing is a bit slow, which might not be for everyone, but it makes the emotional hits feel more real. If you like stories about real-life struggles and family tension, you will enjoy this one.
endingExplained: At the end, the main character finally hits rock bottom. He realizes that his obsession with saving the company cost him his relationship with his wife and his peace of mind. He does not get a magical fix for his money problems, but he finds a moment of clarity. The movie wraps up by showing that while the business might be gone, he has to learn how to be a human being again instead of just a boss.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves realistic stories about life and business struggles.
